examples.arabic: اتعلم اشياء جديدة كل يوم مع الزملاء
examples.english: I learn new things every day with colleagues.
examples.transliteration: Ata'allam ashya' jadidah kull yawm ma'a al-zumala'.

examples.arabic: كان هناك اجتماع مهم مع الزملاء وكنت احاول التركيز
examples.english: There was an important meeting with colleagues, and I was trying to focus.
examples.transliteration: Kana hunaka ijtima' muhimm ma'a al-zumala' wa kuntu uhawilu al-tarkiz.

examples.arabic: واصلت الدكتورة ليلى سيرها عبر البهو، متبادلةً تحيات سريعة مع بعض الزملاء الذين صادفتهم في طريقها.
examples.english: Dr. Layla continued her walk through the hall, exchanging quick greetings with some colleagues she encountered on her way.
examples.transliteration: Wasalati ad-Dukturatu Layla sayraha abra al-bahw, mutabadilatun tahiyyaatin saree'atan ma'a ba'di az-zumala'i allatheena sadifathum fi tareeqiha.
examples.storyTitle: Urgent Greetings at the National Library
